60600.meaning1: element of awakening; factor of enlightenment

examples.text: evaṃ bhāvitesu kho, bhikkhave, sattasu sambojjh'aṅgesu evaṃ bahulīkatesu satta phalā satt'ānisaṃsā pāṭikaṅkhā. katame satta phalā satt'ānisaṃsā?
santaṃ vā ajjhattaṃ dhammavicayasambojjh'aṅgaṃ, atthi me ajjhattaṃ dhammavicayasambojjh'aṅgo'ti pajānāti
lobhassa ca pahānāya dosassa ca pahānāya atthi majjhimā paṭipadā cakkhukaraṇī ñāṇakaraṇī upasamāya abhiññāya sambodhāya nibbānāya saṃvattati
ete kho, bhikkhave, ubho ante anupagamma majjhimā paṭipadā tathāgatena abhisambuddhā, cakkhukaraṇī ñāṇakaraṇī upasamāya abhiññāya sambodhāya nibbānāya saṃvattati.

60602.meaning1: leading to full awakening; culminating in perfect understanding; leading to enlightenment

examples.text: ye te, bhikkhave, kusalā dhammā ariyā niyyānikā sambodhagāmino, tesaṃ vo, bhikkhave, kusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ ariyānaṃ niyyānikānaṃ sambodhagāmīnaṃ kā upanisā savanāyā'ti

yo kho, nāgita, na'y'imassa nekkhammasukhassa pavivekasukhassa upasamasukhassa sambodhasukhassa nikāmalābhī assa akicchalābhī akasiralābhī… so taṃ mīḷhasukhaṃ middhasukhaṃ lābhasakkārasilokasukhaṃ sādiyeyyā'ti.
so ākaṅkhamāno attanā'va attānaṃ byākareyya khīṇanirayo'mhi khīṇatiracchānayoni khīṇapettivisayo khīṇ'āpāyaduggativinipāto sot'āpanno'ham'asmi avinipātadhammo niyato sambodhiparāyaṇo'ti
vijigucchamānassa yadidaṃ phāsu, ritt'āsanaṃ sayanaṃ sevato ce, sambodhikāmassa yath'ānudhammaṃ, taṃ te pavakkhāmi yathā pajānaṃ.

60608.meaning1: related to full awakening; connected with enlightenment
60608.meaningLit: on the side of full awakening

examples.text: sace, bhikkhave, aññatitthiyā paribbājakā evaṃ puccheyyuṃ, sambodhipakkhikānaṃ, āvuso, dhammānaṃ kā upanisā bhāvanāyā'ti, evaṃ puṭṭhā tumhe, bhikkhave, tesaṃ aññatitthiyānaṃ paribbājakānaṃ kin'ti byākareyyāthā'ti?

60609.meaning1: following the path to awakening; (or) remembering the path to awakening

examples.text: tiṇṇaṃ tesaṃ āvasi'n'ettha eko, gandhabbakāy'ūpagato vasīno, dve ca sambodhipath'ānusārino, deve'pi hīḷenti samāhitattā.

60610.meaning1: destined for full awakening; culminating in enlightenment
60610.meaning2: destined for full awakening; culminating in enlightenment
60610.commentary: (MNa) sambodhi paraṃ ayanaṃ gati assā'ti sambodhiparāyaṇo, uparimaggattayaṃ avassaṃ sampāpako'ti attho.

examples.text: idh'ānuruddhā, bhikkhu suṇāti, itthan'nāmo bhikkhu kālaṅ'kato, so bhagavatā byākato, tiṇṇaṃ saṃyojanānaṃ parikkhayā sot'āpanno avinipātadhammo niyato sambodhiparāyaṇo'ti.

60611.meaning1: destined for full awakening; culminating in enlightenment

examples.text: yo, bhikkhave, ime dhamme evaṃ pajānāti evaṃ passati, ayaṃ vuccati, sot'āpanno avinipātadhammo niyato sambodhiparāyano'ti.
santi, bhikkhave, bhikkhū imasmiṃ bhikkhusaṅghe tiṇṇaṃ saṃyojanānaṃ parikkhayā sot'āpannā avinipātadhammā niyatā sambodhiparāyanā, evarūpā'pi, bhikkhave, santi bhikkhū imasmiṃ bhikkhusaṅghe.

60612.meaning1: element of awakening; factor of enlightenment

examples.text: yesaṃ sambodhi'y'aṅgesu, sammā cittaṃ subhāvitaṃ, ādānapaṭinissagge, anupādāya ye ratā, khīṇ'āsavā jutimanto, te loke parinibbutā.
idaṃ vuccati nekkhammasukhaṃ pavivekasukhaṃ upasamasukhaṃ sambodhisukhaṃ. āsevitabbaṃ, bhāvetabbaṃ, bahulīkātabbaṃ, na bhāyitabbaṃ etassa sukhassā'ti, vadāmi.

60616.meaning1: teaches; makes one understand; (or) causes one to wake up

examples.text: paṭibodhentī'ti, bojjh'aṅgā. sambodhentī'ti, bojjh'aṅgā.
āmantesī'ti ālapi abhāsi sambodhesī'ti ayam'ettha attho. aññatra pana ñāpane'pi hoti.

60618.meaning2: eats up; devours together; munches together

examples.text: puna caparaṃ, nigrodha, tapassī aññataraṃ samaṇaṃ vā brāhmaṇaṃ vā apasādetā hoti, kiṃ pan'āyaṃ sambahul'ājīvo sabbaṃ sambhakkheti.

60619.meaning1: broken off; cracked off; snapped off; shattered

examples.text: evañ'hi so, bhante, kakkaṭako sabbehi aḷehi sañchinnehi sambhaggehi sampalibhaggehi abhabbo taṃ pokkharaṇiṃ puna otarituṃ, seyyathā'pi pubbe.

60620.meaning1: breaks off; cracks off; snaps off; shatters

examples.text: yaññad'eva hi so, bhante, kakkaṭako aḷaṃ abhininnāmeyya taṃ tadeva te kumārakā vā kumārikā vā kaṭṭhena vā kathalena vā sañchindeyyuṃ sambhañjeyyuṃ sampalibhañjeyyuṃ.

60621.commentary: (NIDD1a) sambhañjanaparibhañjan'aṭṭhenā'ti sākhābhañjana'ṭṭhena c'eva samantato bhañjitvā rukkhapātan'aṭṭhena ca.

examples.text: rukkhaphal'ūpamā kāmā sambhañjanaparibhañjan'aṭṭhenā'ti passanto vikkhambhanato kāme parivajjeti
idha, visākhe, mātugāmo susaṃvihitakamm'anto hoti, saṅgahitaparijano, bhattu manāpaṃ carati, sambhataṃ anurakkhati.

60625.meaning1: collected; amassed; accumulated; brought together; stored

examples.text: parasambhatesu bhogesu, vasavattī'va modare, diṭṭhe dhamm'esa vipāko, samparāye ca suggatī'ti.
seyyathā'pi, bhikkhave, gimhānaṃ pacchime māse sabbasassesu gām'antasambhatesu gopālako gāvo rakkheyya, tassa rukkhamūlagatassa vā abbhokāsagatassa vā satikaraṇīyam'eva hoti, etā gāvo'ti.
yathāsanthutaṃ nāma yathāmittatā yathāsandiṭṭhatā yathāsambhattatā yathāsamān'upajjhāyakatā yathāsamān'ācariyakatā.

60627.meaning1: fact of association; fact of companionship

examples.text: yathāsanthutaṃ nāma yathāmittatā yathāsandiṭṭhatā yathāsambhattatā yathāsamān'upajjhāyakatā yathāsamān'ācariyakatā.
assaddhā, bhikkhave, nigaṇṭhā, dussīlā, bhikkhave, nigaṇṭhā, ahirikā, bhikkhave, nigaṇṭhā, anottappino, bhikkhave, nigaṇṭhā, asappurisasambhattino, bhikkhave, nigaṇṭhā
evam'eva iminā kāraṇena āyatiṃ avassaṃ bhijjissati, so ca kho kalahavasena na saṅghabhedavasena, tasmā bhinno'ti vuttaṃ. sambhama-atthavasena c'ettha āmeḍitaṃ veditabbaṃ.
ye dukkhaṃ nappajānanti, atho dukkhassa sambhavaṃ, yattha ca sabbaso dukkhaṃ, asesaṃ uparujjhati, tañ'ca maggaṃ na jānanti, dukkh'ūpasamagāminaṃ.
cattāro'me, bhikkhave, āhārā bhūtānaṃ vā sattānaṃ ṭhitiyā sambhava-esīnaṃ vā anuggahāya. katame cattāro?
yaṃ kiñci dukkhaṃ sambhoti, sabbaṃ saṅkhārapaccayā, saṅkhārānaṃ nirodhena, n'atthi dukkhassa sambhavo.
ākiñcaññasambhavaṃ ñatvā, nandī saṃyojanaṃ iti, evam'etaṃ abhiññāya, tato tattha vipassati, etaṃ ñāṇaṃ tathaṃ tassa, brāhmaṇassa vusīmato'ti.
na c'āhaṃ brāhmaṇaṃ brūmi, yonijaṃ mattisambhavaṃ, bhovādi nāma so hoti, sace hoti sakiñcano, akiñcanaṃ anādānaṃ, tam'ahaṃ brūmi brāhmaṇaṃ.
sace, bhikkhave, aññatitthiyā paribbājakā evaṃ puccheyyuṃ, kiṃmūlakā, āvuso, sabbe dhammā, kiṃsambhavā sabbe dhammā, kiṃsamudayā sabbe dhammā

60637.commentary: (THa) sambhavā'ti bhavā. kāmabhav'ādayo eva hi hetupaccayasamavāyena bhavantī'ti idha sambhavā'ti vuttā.

examples.text: sambhavā suviditā asārakā, saṅkhatā pacalitā sad'eritā, taṃ viditvā m'aham'attasambhavaṃ, santim'eva satimā samajjhagan'ti.

60641.meaning1: comes to be; happens; occurs; takes place
60641.meaning2: arises, is produced or present, exists, is together with
60641.synonym: āgacchati, uppajjati, okkamati, kamati, niccharati, byeti, vattati, sambhuṇāti

examples.text: taṇhāpaccayā upādānaṃ, upādānapaccayā bhavo, bhavapaccayā jāti, jātipaccayā jarāmaraṇaṃ soka-parideva-dukkha-domanass'upāyāsā sambhavanti
evam'ass'ime aneke pāpakā akusalā dhammā sambhavanti micchādiṭṭhipaccayā.
etth'ete pāpakā akusalā mānasā abhijjhā'pi byāpādā'pi sārambhā'pi saṃvattanti. t'eva ariyasāvakassa idha'm'anusikkhato antarāyāya sambhavanti.

60645.meaning1: ?? to live together; to be present (with)

60646.notes: According to Geiger §193A this is a rare future active participle, 'for those who will be'. See also Oberlies §82

examples.text: cattāro'me, bhikkhave, āhārā bhūtānaṃ vā sattānaṃ ṭhitiyā sambhav'esīnaṃ vā anuggahāya. katame cattāro?
diṭṭhā vā ye ca adiṭṭhā, ye ca dūre vasanti avidūre bhūtā vā sambhav'esī vā, sabbe sattā bhavantu sukhit'attā.

60647.meaning1: component; part; constituent; collection of things

examples.text: yathā hi aṅgasambhārā, hoti saddo ratho iti, evaṃ khandhesu santesu, hoti satto'ti sammuti.
so evaṃ vadeyya, alaṃ me, bho, tāya vīṇāya, tam'eva me saddaṃ āharathā'ti. tam'enaṃ evaṃ vadeyyuṃ, ayaṃ kho, bhante, vīṇā nāma anekasambhārā mahāsambhārā
surā nāma piṭṭhasurā pūvasurā odanasurā kiṇṇapakkhittā sambhārasaṃyuttā.

60651.meaning1: mixed with ingredients; combined with flavours

examples.text: surā nāma piṭṭhasurā pūvasurā odanasurā kiṇṇapakkhittā sambhārasaṃyuttā.
merayo nāma pupph'āsavo phal'āsavo madhv'āsavo guḷ'āsavo sambhārasaṃyutto.

nivāto nāma nīcamanatā nivātavuttitā, yāya samannāgato puggalo nihatamāno nihatadappo pādapuñchanakacoḷasadiso chinnavisāṇa-usabhasamo uddhaṭadāṭhasappasamo ca hutvā saṇho sakhilo sukhasambhāso hoti, ayaṃ nivāto.

60654.grammar: fem, abstr, act, from sambhāveti, caus

examples.text: mahāsatto… cirakālasamparicitaṃ nekkhamm'ajjhāsayaṃ upabrūhayamāno mahantaṃ bhogakkhandhaṃ pahāya pabbajitu'kāmo hutvā puna cintesi, sac'āhaṃ pabbajissāmi, guṇasambhāvanāpākaṭo bhavissāmī'ti.
n'ānuyuttā tathā eke, muṇḍā saṅghāṭipārutā, sambhāvanaṃ'y'ev'icchanti, lābhasakkāramucchitā.

60657.meaning1: having effected; having caused; having accomplished

examples.text: ayaṃ kho āyasmā mahākaccāno satthu c'eva saṃvaṇṇito sambhāvito ca viññūnaṃ sabrahmacārīnaṃ

ko nu kho, bhikkhave, jātibhūmiyaṃ jātibhūmakānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ sabrahmacārīnaṃ evaṃ sambhāvito, attanā ca app'iccho app'icchakathañ'ca bhikkhūnaṃ kattā, attanā ca santuṭṭho santuṭṭhikathañ'ca bhikkhūnaṃ kattā

60661.meaning2: who has developed causes for good merit

60662.synonym: apaciyati, garukaroti, payirupāsati, pūjeti, sakkaroti, sammāneti

examples.text: tam'enaṃ sabrahmacārī evaṃ sambhāventi, ayaṃ kho āyasmā satthāraṃ upanissāya viharati aññataraṃ vā garuṭṭhāniyaṃ sabrahmacāriṃ, yatth'assa tibbaṃ hir'ottappaṃ paccupaṭṭhitaṃ hoti pemañ'ca gāravo ca.

60665.meaning2: having esteemed, having honoured, having mixed with

60672.meaning1: who has broken the boundary; who has crossed the line; who has gone beyond the limit

examples.text: yāva porāṇānaṃ brāhmaṇānaṃ mariyādo tattha brāhmaṇo na ṭhito taṃ vītikkamatī'ti kho, doṇa, tasmā brāhmaṇo sambhinnamariyādo'ti vuccati. evaṃ kho, doṇa, brāhmaṇo sambhinnamariyādo hoti.

60675.commentary: (VIN 2.5.7.9) sambhuñjeyya vā'ti sambhogo nāma dve sambhogā, āmisasambhogo ca dhammasambhogo ca.

examples.text: yo pana bhikkhu jānaṃ tathāvādinā bhikkhunā akaṭ'ānudhammena taṃ diṭṭhiṃ appaṭinissaṭṭhena saddhiṃ sambhuñjeyya vā saṃvaseyya vā saha vā seyyaṃ kappeyya, pācittiyaṃ.
yo pana bhikkhu jānaṃ tathānāsitaṃ samaṇ'uddesaṃ upalāpeyya vā, upaṭṭhāpeyya vā, sambhuñjeyya vā, saha vā seyyaṃ kappeyya, pācittiyaṃ.

60680.commentary: (ANa) āhārasambhūto'ti āhārena sambhūto āhāraṃ nissāya vaḍḍhito. (ANa) sambhūto'ti uppanno.

examples.text: āhārasambhūto ayaṃ, bhagini, kāyo āhāraṃ nissāya āhāro pahātabbo. taṇhāsambhūto ayaṃ, bhagini, kāyo taṇhaṃ nissāya taṇhā pahātabbā.

60681.meaning1: state of being produced (by); fact of arising (from); state of being composed (of)

60683.commentary: (SNa) saṃbhejja-udakan'ti aññāhi nadīhi saddhiṃ sambhinnaṭṭhāne udakaṃ. (SNt) sambhijjati missībhāvaṃ gacchati etthā'ti sambhejjaṃ, missitaṭṭhānaṃ. tattha udakaṃ sambhejja-udakaṃ. ten'āha sambhinnaṭṭhāne udakan'ti.

examples.text: seyyathā'pi, bhikkhave, yatth'imā mahānadiyo saṃsandanti samenti, seyyath'idaṃ, gaṅgā yamunā aciravatī sarabhū mahī, tato puriso dve vā tīṇi vā udakaphusitāni uddhareyya. taṃ kiṃ maññatha, bhikkhave, katamaṃ nu kho bahutaraṃ, yāni vā dve vā tīṇi vā udakaphusitāni ubbhatāni yaṃ vā sambhejja-udakan'ti?
taṃ kiṃ maññatha, bhikkhave, katamaṃ nu kho bahutaraṃ, yāni vā dve vā tīṇi vā udakaphusitāni ubbhatāni yaṃ vā sambhejjaudakan'ti?
sambhedaṃ loko agamissa, yathā aj'eḷakā kukkuṭasūkarā soṇasigālā.

60687.commentary: (VISM) ath'ānena punappunaṃ mettāyantena attani piyapuggale majjhatte verīpuggale'ti catūsu janesu samacittataṃ sampādentena sīmāsambhedo kātabbo.

examples.text: evaṃ sabbathā'pi karuṇāyitvā vuttanayen'eva attani piyapuggale majjhatte verimhī'ti catūsu janesu sīmāsambhedaṃ katvā
sambhuñjeyya vā'ti sambhogo nāma dve sambhogā, āmisasambhogo ca dhammasambhogo ca.

60690.meaning1: arises; is produced; comes into being; happens

examples.text: dukkham'eva hi sambhoti, dukkhaṃ tiṭṭhati veti ca, n'āññatra dukkhā sambhoti, n'āññaṃ dukkhā nirujjhatī'ti.
dvayaṃ, bhikkhave, paṭicca viññāṇaṃ sambhoti. kathañ'ca, bhikkhave, dvayaṃ paṭicca viññāṇaṃ sambhoti? cakkhuñ'ca paṭicca rūpe ca uppajjati cakkhuviññāṇaṃ.

60692.meaning1: friend; brother; sister; term of familiar address; term of endearment
60692.meaning2: my dear a term of familiar address seen only in vocative

examples.text: seyyathā'pi, bhikkhave, dve sahāyakā sahapaṃsukīḷikā. te kadāci karahaci aññam'aññaṃ samāgaccheyyuṃ. añño pana sahāyako sahāyakaṃ evaṃ vadeyya, idam'pi, samma, sarasi, idam'pi, samma, sarasī'ti. so evaṃ vadeyya, sarāmi, samma, sarāmi, sammā'ti.
bhūtapubbaṃ, bhikkhave, caṇḍālavaṃsiko caṇḍālavaṃsaṃ ussāpetvā medakathālikaṃ antevāsiṃ āmantesi, ehi tvaṃ, samma medakathālike, caṇḍālavaṃsaṃ abhiruhitvā mama uparikhandhe tiṭṭhāhī'ti.
sameto naccagītehi, sammatāḷappabodhano, na tena suddhim'ajjhagaṃ, mārassa visaye rato.
nihīn'atto sabbabhogehi kiccho, sammakkhito samparibhinnagatto, ussāvabindū'va palimpamāno, ajja suve jīvitass'ūparodho.
